title: Cardinality of the odd frequency family
statement: For natural numbers $n$ and $m$ and a coordinate $i\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, the family formed by taking all subsets of the $n$ coordinates of size at most $m$, together with all sets obtained by adjoining $i$ to an $m$-element subset of the other coordinates, has cardinality $\displaystyle \sum_{j=0}^{m}\binom{n}{j}+\binom{n-1}{m}$.
hypotheses_covered: $i$ is a coordinate among the $n$ coordinates
